post.description:
Issue narrow-scoped temporary OSS credentials.

The returned token can ONLY (a) hit `users/<this-user>/<action>/` prefix
of the named bucket, (b) for the requested verb, (c) for the configured
TTL. iOS uses this to upload originals directly without ever holding a
permanent AccessKey — server never sees the bytes (saves bandwidth).

Phase D3 — user-initiated refresh. Writes a new revision; old revision
rows + their wear/feedback references are preserved. Rate-limited per
`TODAY_REFRESH_DAILY_LIMIT` (default 3/d incl. background rev-1).

get.description:
List async jobs filtered by status (default `dead`).

Bounded by `limit<=200` so a single misconfigured query can't pull the
whole table into memory.

User-visible token / call usage for today. Always returns a payload —
when ENABLE_COST_GUARD is off the `limit` field is the unused default
(so the client can pre-render the UI before the operator turns the
feature on).

post.description:
PIPL DSAR — kick off an asynchronous export of the user's personal
data. Bundle path runs as a `user_export` async-job; the user receives
a download link (push / email) when ready. Idempotent per pending
request: re-calling while one is in flight returns the same job_id.

delete.description:
PIPL-aware account deactivation. Soft-deletes immediately; hard-purge
fires after the grace window via the user_purge async-job worker.

Idempotent — calling twice on an already-deactivated account is OK and
returns the same scheduled_purge_at.

I18nMessage.title: I18nMessage
I18nMessage.description:
A renderable explanation token.

- `key` is a stable dotted identifier (`obstacle.laundry`, `prep.iron`).
  Clients lookup their own locale bundle by this key.
- `params` is a flat string-keyed dict; values must be JSON-serializable
  and already client-safe (no internal IDs, no PII).
- `fallback_text` is the server-rendered zh-CN string. REQUIRED.
  Clients without a locale bundle for `key` display this verbatim.

TodayContextResponse.title: TodayContextResponse
TodayContextResponse.description:
Phase D — context snapshot the engine saw at generation time. Surfaced
only when ENABLE_TODAY_CONTEXT=true; absent on rows generated before
Phase D landed.
